column5: Look: bright, cartoon 3D, low-poly with rounded chunky shapes; golden sandstone walls with şəbəkə lattice windows and wooden balconies, red-and-blue carpets with buta patterns, blue Caspian sky, Qız Qalası standing on the horizon. Cırtdan is tiny with a red papaq, patterned vest and a patched bread sack; the Div is big, furry, horned, round-bellied, with a club, comic not scary. Warm late-afternoon light. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.

column5: A menu on the title: Oyna, Nənənin dükanı, Personajlar, Tapşırıqlar
Nənənin dükanı: 5 levels per power-up (longer each level), flying carpets to keep, Nənənin bağlaması (a random gift)
Characters: Cırtdan, Tıq-Tıq xanım (5 000 bread), Keçəl (3 mission sets), Kəndirbaz (10 000 bread); Məlikməmməd, Pəri qız, Kosa shown locked until their events
Music: a 6/8 dance in the Şur mode, synthesised tar, balaban and nağara over a modern kick; calm in the menu, faster with speed, epic with the Simurq
Voices: the Div's "Ay Cırtdaaan!" and "Hamm!", "Yenə sənsən?!", Cırtdan's giggle, sung by a small formant synth
The opening story in five staged pictures, from the GDD's intro (first Oyna, and Nağıl in the menu)

Word hunt: a word (NOVRUZ, XALÇA, TƏNDİR, NAĞARA...) lies in the street letter by letter, in order; spelling it gives Nənənin bağlaması and the next word starts at once, as many as you like; the day's first word keeps a streak of days (up to 3 bundles)

Festivals by the calendar or chosen in Tədbirlər: Novruz (bonfires to jump, səməni, şəkərbura and paxlava that unlock Kosa), Qış (snow, the Div in a scarf and hat), Nar bayramı (pomegranate trees, twice the nar); Xəzər yayı shown as coming
The Simurq feather in every run by about the 14th row, and power-ups more often (the Simurq was too rare to meet)
Run along the camels' backs; a hay cart with a ramp often waits in the next lane to jump across from; a head-on hit with the caravan still ends the run

Şəki, the first city of the Azerbaijan tour: whitewashed stone houses with red tiled roofs and deep wooden eyvans, the Xan sarayı and green mountains on the horizon, Şəki halvası worth 5 bread; chosen in Şəhərlər

Qəbələ: a forest trail of packed earth and leaves, pines and autumn oaks, log huts, green mountains with a waterfall; stumps to jump, fallen trunks to slide under, mossy boulders to swerve round, fındıq worth 3 bread

The whole Azerbaijan tour open: Naxçıvan (brick houses with turquoise bands, Möminə xatın türbəsi, İlandağ, salt crystals), Lənkəran (tea rows, rain, lighthouse, naringi), Quba (apple orchards, carpet looms, snowy Şahdağ, apples), Qobustan (carved rocks, mud volcanoes, the Caspian); each with its own obstacle looks and treat
Missions: three at a time from the GDD's list; finishing all three raises the base multiplier by one for good
